results.notes: Fails heavily on profile/sideways faces; zero temporal tracking; high false-positive rate on textures.
Detects people reliably, but top 35% box is too wide (covers torso/shoulders) or misses chin when seated/leaning.
Excellent frontal accuracy, but drops faces on 90° profile/turns; causes high track fragmentation (excessive track IDs).
Stable tracking; preserves identity across full clip; detects profile ears/eyes when facing sideways.
Best overall: 100% profile recall via pose fallback, exact frontal alignment with comfortable margins, zero phantom track clutter.
